description: Read the latest 100 retained change observations for one saved search owned by the authenticated private workspace. Does not change the search. Retention and missing intermediate observations are explicit; observations are not proof of delivered notifications.

id.description: Saved search UUID returned by create_saved_search or list_saved_searches, owned by this workspace.

name: get_saved_search_events

events.description: Up to the latest 100 observed changes, newest first.
